selector.rationale: The presence of numerous eosinophils and superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation supports drug-induced eosinophilic dermatitis, which is also consistent with the recent initiation of a new immunotherapy regimen.

rejected.label: Pembrolizumab-induced rash
rejected.why: Too broad, as the rash could be caused by either pembrolizumab or ipilimumab

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatitis
rejected.why: Similar to pembrolizumab-induced rash, it's too broad and doesn't account for the eosinophilic nature of the rash

rejected.label: Eosinophilic cellulitis
rejected.why: The biopsy findings do not support cellulitis, and the clinical presentation is more consistent with dermatitis

rejected.label: Immune-related adverse event (irAE) of immunotherapy
rejected.why: Too broad, as it encompasses many possible adverse events and does not specifically account for the eosinophilic nature of the rash
